result.summary: A WorkOS 404 on organization delete is an expected condition: the deleter step removes the organization, then the sync handler deletes it again. The fix maps only 404 to entity_not_found and treats that as success, matching the membership and role deletes, while other errors still fail.

problems.title: Two owners of the same delete
problems.detail: The deleter step and the workspace_deleted handler both delete the same WorkOS organization. The PR makes both idempotent instead of picking one owner, which is acceptable but leaves the redundancy.

problems.title: Source of the Datadog error not proven
problems.detail: The error text comes from the shared aggregate log, so it could come from the deleter retry or the handler. The description blames only the handler without a trace. Both paths are fixed anyway.

problems.title: Tests do not join the layers
problems.detail: The unit test mocks the SDK and the litest mocks the WorkOS client. No test goes from a real 404 through the client mapping and the aggregate to the handler result.

problems.title: Any 404 counts as deleted
problems.detail: A wrong organization ID or the wrong WorkOS environment would now be reported as already deleted. This is the same trade-off the membership and role deletes already make.

result.betterFix: Keep this change. Optionally have one place own the WorkOS organization delete (deleter step or event handler), or add a litest that goes from the deleter step to the sync handler.
